name: quarterdeck-goals
description: Runs Quarterdeck goals in background subagents and puts them beside the chat: approve or reject proposals, run, pause and inspect goals, and let Claude check on them

url.title: Quarterdeck web app address (optional)
url.description: Only for "Open in browser" links. Goals run without the web app.

poll_seconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check for changes. Runs in progress are checked every 5 seconds; offline checks back off to a minute.

max_concurrent_runs.title: Goal runs at once
max_concurrent_runs.description: How many goal runs this session starts at the same time, each in its own background subagent.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Which events raise a toast and notification.

os_notifications.title: System notifications
os_notifications.description: Also send alerts through your notification channel, so you hear about them while working elsewhere.

phone_push.title: Phone push from the plugin
phone_push.description: Push alerts to the Claude app from the plugin itself. Off by default: Claude Code reports these pushes as sent but doesn't deliver them yet (phone relay does the job meanwhile).

phone_relay.title: Phone notifications (through Claude)
phone_relay.description: When you haven't typed in this session for 5 minutes, an alert is passed to Claude, which pushes it to the Claude app on your phone (with Remote Control connected and mobile push on in /config). Each alert costs a short turn. Reply in the session to approve or reject.
